answer: Every epoch the protocol splits rewards into 64 buckets keyed by the hash of a wallet's funding ancestor, then caps each bucket at 2 percent of the pool. A farmer who spawns k fake identities under one funder still shares a single cap, so the marginal reward of identity k falls like 1/k while its fixed cost stays constant. Validators recompute ancestry from the public ledger, and a signal tundra of coordinated transfers into a haven wallet merges buckets automatically.
